mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate below 3.5% triggers a bearish labor market adjustment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 3.5%, or the 5d returns are not more negative than a 10-year average during such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rates and decline in unemployment rate signals conflicting policy signals, fostering market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when both proxies meet the trigger, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC > 0.05 over 5-year window).

mechanism_narrative: An upward surge in the INDPRO index above 110.0 indicates robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 110.0, or the 60d returns are not higher than a 5-year average during such supply booms.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in federal funds rates below 2.0% signals an impending policy shift, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods when FEDFUNDS decline, or the 20d returns do not exceed a 5-year average in such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 152,000 triggers a labor market overheating scenario, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 152,000, or the 20d returns are not more negative than a 5-year average during such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A faster growth in demand (GDPC1) compared to supply (INDPRO) by over 2% quarterly signals excess demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the growth condition is met, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (IC > 0.05 over 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in federal funds rates below 2.5% signals policy accommodation, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during post-shock recovery periods when FEDFUNDS decline, or the 20d returns do not exceed a 5-year average in such regimes.
